SELECT p.player_name,
       CAST((p.height / 2.54) / 12 AS INTEGER) || ' ft ' || ROUND((p.height / 2.54) - (CAST((p.height / 2.54) / 12 AS INTEGER) * 12)) || ' in' AS height_ft_in
FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT pa1.player_api_id, pa1.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa1
    WHERE pa1.date = (
        SELECT MAX(pa2.date)
        FROM Player_Attributes pa2
        WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa1.player_api_id
    )
) pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC;

    p.player_name,
    CAST(p.height / 30.48 AS INTEGER) || ''' ' || 
    CAST(ROUND((p.height - (CAST(p.height / 30.48 AS INTEGER) * 30.48)) / 2.54, 0) AS TEXT) || '"' AS height
FROM "Player" p
JOIN "Player_Attributes" pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY MAX(pa.overall_rating) DESC

WITH latest_attr AS (
    SELECT pa.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
)
SELECT p.player_name AS full_name,
       (CAST((p.height * 0.393700787) / 12 AS INTEGER)) || "'" ||
       ROUND((p.height * 0.393700787) - (CAST((p.height * 0.393700787) / 12 AS INTEGER) * 12), 0) || '"' AS height_ft_in
FROM Player p
JOIN latest_attr la ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
ORDER BY la.overall_rating DESC;

WITH player_stats AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_api_id,
        AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall,
        AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing,
        AVG(pa.short_passing) AS avg_short_passing,
        AVG(pa.dribbling) AS avg_dribbling,
        AVG(pa.ball_control) AS avg_ball_control,
        AVG(pa.acceleration) AS avg_acceleration,
        AVG(pa.sprint_speed) AS avg_sprint_speed,
        AVG(pa.aggression) AS avg_aggression,
        AVG(pa.interceptions) AS avg_interceptions,
        AVG(pa.positioning) AS avg_positioning,
        AVG(pa.vision) AS avg_vision,
        AVG(pa.penalties) AS avg_penalties,
        AVG(pa.marking) AS avg_marking,
        AVG(pa.standing_tackle) AS avg_standing_tackle,
        AVG(pa.sliding_tackle) AS avg_sliding_tackle
    FROM "Player_Attributes" pa
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM "Player" p
JOIN player_stats s ON p.player_api_id = s.player_api_id

             WHEN num = 14 THEN away_player_3
             WHEN num = 15 THEN away_player_4
             WHEN num = 16 THEN away_player_5

             WHEN num = 19 THEN away_player_8
             WHEN num = 20 THEN away_player_9
             WHEN num = 21 THEN away_player_10
             WHEN num = 22 THEN away_player_11
        END AS player_api_id

    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 1 AS num UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5

        UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15
        UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20
        UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22
    ) nums
    WHERE Match.season = '2010/2011'
      AND League.name = 'England Premier League'
) AND player_api_id IS NOT NULL;

  SELECT away_player_9 FROM matches_2010_11 UNION

WITH latest_attrs AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) md ON pa.player_api_id = md.player_api_id AND pa.date = md.max_date
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       la.overall_rating,
       CASE
           WHEN la.overall_rating >= 85 THEN 'world-class'
           WHEN la.overall_rating >= 75 THEN 'elite'
           WHEN la.overall_rating >= 65 THEN 'competent'
           ELSE 'other'
       END AS excellence_level
FROM latest_attrs la
JOIN "Player" p ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
ORDER BY CASE
            WHEN la.overall_rating >= 85 THEN 1
            WHEN la.overall_rating >= 75 THEN 2
            WHEN la.overall_rating >= 65 THEN 3
            ELSE 4
         END,
         la.overall_rating DESC;

WITH LatestAttributes AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY id DESC) as rn
    FROM "Player_Attributes"
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN la.overall_rating >= 90 THEN 'World-Class'
        WHEN la.overall_rating >= 85 THEN 'Elite'
        ELSE 'Competent'
    END AS excellence_level
FROM LatestAttributes la
JOIN "Player" p ON la.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
ORDER BY la.overall_rating DESC

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) md ON pa.player_api_id = md.player_api_id AND pa.date = md.max_date
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       CASE
         WHEN l.overall_rating >= 90 THEN 'World Class'
         WHEN l.overall_rating >= 80 THEN 'Elite Professional'
         WHEN l.overall_rating >= 70 THEN 'Mid-Tier Professional'
         ELSE 'Developing Talent'
       END AS tier
FROM Player p
JOIN latest l ON p.player_api_id = l.player_api_id;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name,
       CASE 
           WHEN pa.overall_rating >= 90 THEN 'World Class'
           WHEN pa.overall_rating >= 80 THEN 'Elite Professional'
           WHEN pa.overall_rating >= 70 THEN 'Mid-Tier Professional'
           ELSE 'Developing Talent'
       END AS performance_tier
FROM Player_Attributes pa
INNER JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC;

WITH latest_attr AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN la.overall_rating >= 85 THEN 'World Class'
        WHEN la.overall_rating >= 80 THEN 'Elite Professional'
        WHEN la.overall_rating >= 70 THEN 'Mid-Tier Professional'
        ELSE 'Developing Talent'
    END AS performance_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT la.player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM latest_attr la
WHERE la.rn = 1
GROUP BY performance_tier
ORDER BY CASE performance_tier
    WHEN 'World Class' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Elite Professional' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Mid-Tier Professional' THEN 3
    ELSE 4 END;

votes.sql:
SELECT pa.player_fifa_api_id,
       pa.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN (
    SELECT player_fifa_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_fifa_api_id
) latest
  ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = latest.player_fifa_api_id
  AND pa.date = latest.max_date
WHERE pa.overall_rating >= 85
ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC;

    SELECT pa.player_fifa_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_fifa_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes

SELECT player_name, (weight * 10000.0) / (height * height) AS bmi
FROM Player
WHERE height > 0
  AND (weight * 10000.0) / (height * height) BETWEEN 18.5 AND 24.9;

    p.player_name,
    ROUND(
        CAST(p.weight AS REAL) / (CAST(p.height AS REAL) / 100.0) / (CAST(p.height AS REAL) / 100.0),
        2
    ) AS bmi
FROM 
    Player p
WHERE 
    CAST(p.weight AS REAL) / (CAST(p.height AS REAL) / 100.0) / (CAST(p.height AS REAL) / 100.0)
    BETWEEN 18.5 AND 24.9

SELECT p.player_name, pa.max_overall AS overall_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(overall_rating) AS max_overall
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
    HAVING MAX(overall_rating) >= 80
) pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id;

votes.sql:
WITH latest_attr AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM "Player_Attributes" pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM "Player_Attributes"
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
)
SELECT p.player_name, la.overall_rating
FROM "Player" p
JOIN latest_attr la ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
WHERE la.overall_rating >= 85
ORDER BY la.overall_rating DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH latest_attrs AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) lm ON pa.player_api_id = lm.player_api_id AND pa.date = lm.max_date
)
SELECT p.player_name, la.overall_rating
FROM latest_attrs la
JOIN Player p ON la.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE la.overall_rating >= 85
ORDER BY la.overall_rating DESC;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    MAX(pa.overall_rating) AS overall_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating >= 85
GROUP BY p.player_fifa_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY overall_rating DESC

           la.preferred_foot,
           CASE
               WHEN (la.overall_rating + la.potential)/2.0 >= 80 THEN 5
               WHEN (la.overall_rating + la.potential)/2.0 >= 70 THEN 4
               WHEN (la.overall_rating + la.potential)/2.0 >= 60 THEN 3
               WHEN (la.overall_rating + la.potential)/2.0 >= 50 THEN 2
               ELSE 1
           END AS star_level
    FROM latest_attr la
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
    WHERE la.rn = 1
)
SELECT player_name, star_level, preferred_foot
FROM player_star
WHERE star_level = 5;

WITH latest_attr AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id,
           MAX(pa.date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN latest_attr la ON la.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id AND la.max_date = pa.date
WHERE pa.vision >= 80
  AND pa.short_passing >= 80
  AND pa.long_passing >= 80
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "Match" m
        JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
        WHERE l.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
          AND (
                m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_2 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) m ON pa.player_api_id = m.player_api_id AND pa.date = m.max_date
) latest ON p.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id
WHERE latest.overall_rating >= 85;

)

FROM Player p
JOIN latest_attr la ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
WHERE la.overall_rating >= 85 AND la.potential >= 85;

WITH qualified AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT substr(pa.date, 1, 4)) AS year_cnt,
           MAX(pa.potential) AS max_pot
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    WHERE pa.potential >= 85
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT substr(pa.date, 1, 4)) >= 2
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       q.max_pot AS max_potential
FROM qualified q
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = q.player_api_id;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id,
           MAX(overall_rating) - MIN(overall_rating) AS rating_gain,
           AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
    HAVING rating_gain >= 10
       AND avg_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
) pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating > (
    SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
HAVING MAX(pa.overall_rating) - MIN(pa.overall_rating) >= 5
ORDER BY MAX(pa.overall_rating) DESC;

WITH player_stats AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id,
           MIN(pa.overall_rating) AS min_overall,
           MAX(pa.overall_rating) AS max_overall,
           AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall
    FROM "Player_Attributes" pa
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
),
global_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS overall_avg
    FROM "Player_Attributes"
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN "Player" p ON p.player_api_id = ps.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
WHERE (ps.max_overall - ps.min_overall) >= 10
  AND ps.avg_overall > ga.overall_avg;
}
